svg.title: P004 · Customer emails that cannot be delivered
svg.desc: One row per customer with an email issue. Asha has no address, Ben's contains a space and Cia's fails the requested pattern. Dev gets NULL in the issue column. Only IDs 1, 2 and 3 remain. The final query orders the flagged customers by ID. FROM Customers · one table is enough. The contact list needs one decision per person. The stored email and the identity of the person to contact are already on the same customer row.
